name: Finite-width optical critical-point design
capability: Conditional 2D normal-shift design: finite-width criticality, competing optical edge and independent projector reference
units: Model energy in eV; dimensionless k; d2k/(2pi)^2; Gaussian sigma / Lorentzian HWHM; SI prefactor and thickness omitted
limits: Explicit insulating three-orbital paths and conditional local normal form; no material/DFT or global optimum certification
Projector reference only for smooth isolated scalar-energy subspaces; no flattening of split bands
Spectral convolution is not a microscopic lifetime; full SHG, excitons and device efficiency excluded
Real Wannier optical operators require independent same-gauge validation
